header.description: What: Simulated devices SD-S5c (§3.13d D-113 - D-115, R-4300). The Observer carries a laser target designator (kit 1; TKB 643: a lase lasts at most 60 s, then the laser cools 30 s; its PRF code starts at 1688 and CODE steps it to the next valid code, each digit in its proven range: 1 / 1-7 / 1-8 / 1-8). A scripted trainee possesses him, binds his view to the designator and aims at a marker 450 m away; POWER; CODE once (1688 -> 1711); LASE at 4 s and holds it past the duty limit; a CODE press while lasing and a LASE press while cooling; after the cool-down the run PAUSES for 120 frames and he presses LASE inside the pause (paused frame 10). Judge: (1) the phase runs OFF -> STANDBY -> LASING -> COOLING (at the 60 s limit) -> STANDBY (30 s later) -> LASING (the queued lase); (2) the code is 1688 after POWER and 1711 after CODE, and the presses while lasing / cooling are refused (the code stays, the cooling runs on); (3) while lasing the laser meets the marker and is a live designation; (4) the LASE pressed in the pause is QUEUED - nothing is designated on any paused frame - and the lase starts on the first live frame after it; (5) the HUD shows LASING, then COOLING, then 'queued' in the pause. Fail: a lase past 60 s, a lase while cooling, a code changed outside STANDBY, or a designation inside the pause. Check: scripts/scenario-regression.sh dv-ltd-procedure
